stem: A Massachusetts pharmacy's computerized system cannot show what it previously dispensed to a patient until an overnight batch runs, so at the counter the pharmacist cannot see the patient's earlier fills. The pharmacy says its staff always ask patients thoroughly about their history. Which statements are correct? Select all that apply.

choices.text: Thorough questioning satisfies the retrieval requirement, since the goal is the same.
The retrieval requirement is measured by reasonable effort, as the content duty is.
The system must allow immediate retrieval when the prescription is presented.
A pharmacy may rely on the overnight batch if it documents the limitation.
Institutional sterile compounding pharmacies are outside these requirements.

explanation.core_reasoning: 247 CMR 9.16(7) states two duties of different character. The CONTENT duty is qualified by reasonable effort, but the system duty is not: the computerized pharmacy system SHALL provide for the IMMEDIATE RETRIEVAL of information necessary to identify previously dispensed drugs AT THE TIME THE PRESCRIPTION IS PRESENTED. 247 CMR 9.16(8) excludes institutional sterile compounding pharmacies from 247 CMR 9.16 altogether.

choice_analysis.A: Questioning the patient goes to the content duty, not to the system capability.
choice_analysis.B: The reasonable-effort standard qualifies the content duty only.
choice_analysis.C: Correct: immediate retrieval at the time of presentation.
choice_analysis.D: Documenting a limitation does not satisfy an unqualified requirement.
choice_analysis.E: Correct: the section does not apply to them.

related_facts: The content duty reaches allergies, reactions, dispensed medications and pharmacist comments
explanation.mpje_trap: Candidates carry the reasonable-effort standard across the whole paragraph and excuse a system that cannot retrieve in time.

reasoning_steps: Separate the effort-qualified content duty from the unqualified system duty
Apply the immediate-retrieval requirement to the batch delay
Apply the institutional sterile compounding carve-out
